title: DeltaLLM: Delta-Key Sparse Attention for Edge LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2507.19608v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-device LLM inference is increasingly important for edge platforms but remains challenging due to high computational and memory demands and tight resource constraints. Modern applications often involve long prompts. Although compact models reduce linear-layer costs through weight compression, attention remains largely unoptimized and becomes the dominant bottleneck, especially during prefilling. Existing attention pruning methods primarily target highly parallel hardware (e.g., GPUs) and long context windows, limiting their suitability for edge scenarios. We present DeltaLLM, a training-free LLM framework based on algorithm-hardware-dataflow co-design to accelerate prefilling attention. DeltaLLM introduces a causal-attention-aware K-only delta formulation that enables Delta-Key reuse across query heads under Grouped-Query Attention (GQA). translated_title: DeltaLLM：面向边缘大语言模型的Delta键稀疏注意力
translated_abstract: 设备端LLM推理对边缘平台而言日益重要，但由于高计算与内存需求以及严格的资源限制，仍面临诸多挑战。现代应用通常涉及长提示词。尽管紧凑模型通过权重压缩降低了线性层的开销，但注意力机制在很大程度上仍未被优化，成为主要瓶颈，尤其是在预填充阶段。现有的注意力剪枝方法主要面向高度并行的硬件（如GPU）和长上下文窗口，限制了其在边缘场景中的适用性。我们提出了DeltaLLM，这是一个无需训练的LLM框架，基于算法-硬件-数据流协同设计来加速预填充阶段的注意力计算。DeltaLLM引入了一种因果感知的仅K（K-only）delta表示方法，使其能够在分组查询注意力（GQA）机制下跨查询头实现Delta-Key的复用。同时，一种上下文感知的混合策略在对角线附近保留精确注意力，并在其他区域应用delta近似，以降低计算与访存开销，从而适应边缘设备严苛的资源约束。
tldr: DeltaLLM是一个无需训练的边缘端LLM加速框架，通过算法-硬件-数据流协同设计，利用因果感知的K-only delta表示实现GQA下的Delta-Key跨查询头复用，并结合上下文感知的混合策略在对角线附近保留精确注意力，从而加速长提示词预填充阶段的注意力计算。
en_tdlr: DeltaLLM is a training-free framework that accelerates attention prefilling on edge devices via algorithm-hardware-dataflow co-design, introducing a causal-attention-aware K-only delta formulation that enables Delta-Key reuse across query heads under GQA, along with a context-aware hybrid strategy that preserves exact attention near the diagonal.
